question: Does the Lightning AI free tier (10 GB free storage) require a phone number, and is the identity_cost.kind for this record 'email' or 'any-phone'?
why: The AI Studio docs state 'Verify your phone number to receive up to 80 free GPU hours to start,' but the storage free tier's signup gate was not established and no account was created. Do not overwrite identity_cost.kind without evidence.
